channel.title: Majid Ershadi Articles
channel.description: Security architecture, resilient infrastructure, threat intelligence, API integration, application security, Splunk engineering, and SSDLC.

item.title: VMware Vision 1.1.1: A Practical VMware Activity Trail in Splunk
item.description: Install VMware Vision and its ingestion add-on, configure VMware and CIM data models, and understand what syslog can tell you about VM changes.

item.title: REST Profiler 1.1.0: Reliable API Workflows from Splunk
item.description: A first-hand engineering account of reusable request profiles, encrypted bodies, safe previews, result delivery, retries, validation, mutual TLS, and operational boundaries.

item.title: MISPFuse 2.2.4: A Safer Bridge from Splunk to MISP
item.description: The engineering story of server-validated mappings, controlled event grouping, encrypted MISP credentials, hardened packaging, and honest Splunk compatibility.

item.title: SC4S in Production: What Broke, Why I Changed the Architecture, and How I Fixed It
item.description: A FortiGate and Bitdefender migration story about HEC routing, parser boundaries, buffering, high-load tuning, and the failures that made the architecture clearer.

item.title: SmartPath DNS: Engineering an Adaptive Local Resolver for Unreliable Networks
item.description: A detailed engineering tour of multi-protocol resolver racing, adaptive priority, persistent caching, GEO selection, resource guardrails, and optional Ghosting.

item.title: Building Secure Splunk Apps in a Moving Ecosystem
item.description: Updated with the UCC-generated base.html AppInspect bug, my two-application reproduction, public triage, and the Splunkbase policy change that reopened publication.
